requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards, guaranteeing legal accountability and ethical practices.
The system shall implement role-based access control and define user permissions to ensure security and prevent unauthorized access.
The system shall maintain a unified audit trail of all transactions, ensuring immutability and retention for a minimum of 7 years.
The system shall validate data input and ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall integrate energy-efficient algorithms in transaction processing to balance performance and energy consumption.
The system shall provide users with functionalities to detect and alert about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms for fault tolerance and recovery during transaction processing.
The system shall ensure regular backups of financial data to prevent data loss in case of system failure.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all user access and modifications for review.
The system shall provide multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates for fairness in international transactions.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall provide sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint associated with local server maintenance.
The system shall enable users to offset carbon emissions from transactions through integrated carbon credit options.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall maintain an audit trail that logs each transaction with a maximum logging delay of 1 second.
